# FG-AGENT-0005

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `scan_flags_undeclared_child_process` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: エージェントの部品が、宣言していない能力（コマンドの実行、ネットワーク、権限の設定）を使っているか、検査できない書き方をしています。
- en: The agent part uses a capability it does not declare (running commands, network, permission settings), or code the scan cannot check.
- id: Bagian agen menggunakan kemampuan yang tidak dideklarasikan (menjalankan perintah, jaringan, pengaturan izin), atau kode yang tidak dapat diperiksa.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 16 §8 (ADR-0032 §5, Amendment 2026-11-14): forge-agent's static scan found, in a part's files: `undeclared_child_process` (`child_process` / `cluster`; a hook command — settings.json `hooks`, another JSON `command`, `hooks:` in Markdown front matter — that is not exactly `node <.claude/… .js of this part>`; a slash command's inline bash `` !` ``; an MCP server with `command`; without the `exec` capability), `undeclared_network` (http / https / net / tls / dgram / dns / undici, `fetch`, `WebSocket`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `EventSource`, an MCP `url`, without `network`), `undeclared_permissions` (`permissions` in settings.json), `undeclared_fs_write` (writeFile, appendFile, createWriteStream, unlink, rename, mkdir, copyFile, symlink, chmod, truncate, rmSync, … without `fs-write`), `settings_key_not_allowed` (a settings.json key other than $schema, hooks, permissions, model, includeCoAuthoredBy, cleanupPeriodDays, outputStyle — statusLine, apiKeyHelper, env … run or change what the scan cannot judge), `hook_target_not_in_part` (a `node` hook naming a script the part does not ship), or `dynamic_code` (code the scan cannot follow: any `\u` escape; the identifiers eval, Function, Reflect, constructor, binding, _linkedBinding, dlopen, mainModule, createRequire, getBuiltinModule, globalThis, global; `process` not followed by `.`; `import` as a call; a `require` that is not one plain string literal; the modules vm / worker_threads / module / inspector / v8 / wasi). Every file that is not Markdown or JSON is scanned as a script (node runs any extension), as identifiers, so spacing and comments between tokens change nothing. `dynamic_code`, `settings_key_not_allowed` and `hook_target_not_in_part` are refused even when every capability is declared.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

`gstn agent verify --part <dir> --json`: each problem's `reason` and `subject` (the file; for dynamic_code also the construct).

## 対処 (fix)

Declare the capability in part.toml's `capabilities` (the marketplace shows it to everyone who installs the part), or remove the use. For `dynamic_code`, write a plain `require('<name>')`; reword a comment that names a refused construct.
